title: Make migration backup dirs unique per attempt, not per second
goal: VC-201-065 refuted: backup_tree names the durable backup .migrate-bak-<epoch-seconds>, so an interrupted migration re-run within the same second overwrites the preserved pre-migration config.json with mid-migration state; rollback then cannot restore the previous usable configuration. Use a unique-per-attempt name (nanos/pid/counter) or refuse to reuse a non-empty backup dir. Evidence: vc_201_065_mastery_rerun_in_same_second_clobbers_durable_backup.
